## Integration facts

- API base: https://routerhub.si/v1.
- Current model IDs, prices, protocols, and availability: https://routerhub.si/models.json.
- The documented GLM entries list Chat Completions. Do not infer Messages or Responses support from a shared key.
- glm-5.3-abliterated is listed as an abliterated research variant, not independently verified here.
- glm-5.3-uncensored is a fixed-prompt persona that replaces customer system/developer messages. It is not a separately verified uncensored fine-tune.
- Billing is prepaid and usage-based. Check the checkout screen for card and crypto options.
- Provider retention terms apply. Do not assume zero retention.
- External prompt files are linked, not bundled. Local docs and examples are RouterHub-authored.
- No live benchmark results or guarantees of refusal-free output are claimed.
